title: Generalize Trinity Directed Port Graph
description: Trinity operates on general directed property port graphs, not DAGs. Remove DAG-only canvas assumptions (enforce_acyclic), wire reorganize to shared force layout, generalize flatPosition derivation for disconnected components, and extend force-graph schema allowlist.
summary:
Repo-wide cleanup removing legacy bridges and V1 version suffixes across ~170+ files.

Phase 1: Removed Golden Layout conversion, image: prefix stripping, TrinityJackResultV1, deprecated brush budget aliases, deprecated IconSelector props, kindsCompatible test helper.

Phase 2: Migrated compose kit fixtures to block {hash,items} format; deleted array-vs-block dual parsing; migrated puzzle2d/5d/wires hierarchy onClick to command descriptors; removed legacyActivate; added concrete-forest manifest and migrated concrete-forest.2d.json to manifestId + circle nodes; removed kindCatalogs fallback and rectangle normalization.

Phases 3-4: Bulk-stripped V1 suffix from ~90 types/structs/functions/MIME constants and /v1 from schema/play-surface strings across the monorepo; regenerated graph manifests and puzzle2d/sequence wasm pkg bindings.

Verification: cargo test puzzle_2d (115/116 pass), sequence wasm rebuild OK; puzzle2d-react vitest has pre-existing scene test failures unrelated to schema rename; flow wasm rebuild blocked by unrelated kernel_3d_brepkit compile error.
